event_chain.summary: Azure DevOps repositories cloned; source code and keys taken and offered for sale

summary: In July 2026 a threat actor known as "888" offered for sale on a cybercrime forum about 35 GB of data allegedly stolen from Accenture, including source code, RSA and SSH keys, Azure personal access tokens, Azure Storage access keys and configuration files from Azure DevOps repositories; a screenshot appeared to show the cloning of an Accenture DevOps repository. Accenture confirmed it was aware of an 'isolated matter', said it had remediated its source and that operations and service delivery were not affected, but did not say how access was gained or whether client data was involved.
